description: Angular component for configuring calculated fields, supporting script and simple configurations, with form validation, dynamic form controls, and script testing.

classes.name: SimpleConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for simple/calculated field configuration, with form controls, validation, and script testing.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updates form accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form with provided configuration value.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch events (not used).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: onTestScript
methods.description: Triggers script testing and updates the script expression.

methods.name: updatedModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current form state.

methods.name: updatedFormWithScript
methods.description: Switches form controls based on script mode.

methods.name: toggleScopeByOutputType
methods.description: Enables/disables 'useLatestTs' based on output type and script mode.
